data.long_meaning: Ridhi is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Wealth', 'Prosperity', and 'Growth'. In Hindu mythology, Ridhi is one of the seven goddesses of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth. Dogra is a surname of Indian origin. The name RidhiDogra carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity, Growth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose RidhiDogra usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity, growth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
